name: @perfagent/agent
description: Real-user snippet: Web Vitals, fetch/XHR, WebSocket, long tasks, errors, memory and browser AI calls, sent to the local PerfAgent dashboard. No cookies, no PII, fail-silent, under 8 KB.

scripts.build: esbuild src/agent.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/perfagent.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node -e "console.log('perfagent.js ' + require('fs').statSync('dist/perfagent.js').size + ' bytes')"
